data.name: Southern-Hemisphere-Seasons
data.teaser: The Southern-Hemisphere-Seasons mod aligns the in-game seasons with the real-world seasons for players in the Southern Hemisphere.
data.description:
Overview

Automatically adjusts the in-game season based on the southern hemisphere dates and the system date, ensuring that the season reflects the real-world time of year.

Installation

1. Download and Extract:

- Download the mod package zip from releases and extract it into your SPT directory.

2. Configuration:

- The mod comes with a config file where you can enable or disable the mod, force a season etc.

Config Options

The mod includes several configuration options that can be adjusted in the config folder.

> SPT 3.11.x version:

- “enabled”: true, // enable or disable the mod

- “stormChance”: 0.1, // chance for a storm during Summer (0 to 1 - where 0.1 = 10% / 0.2 = 20% etc)

- “forceSeason”: null // force a specific season (null = auto, 0 = Summer, 1 = Autumn, 2 = Winter, 3 = Spring, 4 = Late Autumn, 5 = Early Spring, 6 = Storm)

------------------------------------------------------------------------

> SPT 4.0.0 version:

- “enabled”: true, // enable or disable the mod

- “forceSeason”: null, // force a specific season (null = auto, 0 = Summer, 1 = Autumn, 2 = Winter, 3 = Spring, 4 = Late Autumn, 5 = Early Spring) - “allowEventSeason”: false // if true, let SPT seasonal events (e.g. Christmas) override this mod’s season (default: false)

How It Works

1. Season Determination: The mod calculates the current season based on the server’s system date and time. It follows the Southern Hemisphere’s seasonal calendar:

- Summer: December 1 - February 28

- Autumn: March 1 - April 30

- Late Autumn: May 1 - May 31

- Winter: June 1 - August 31

- Early Spring: September 1 - September 30

- Spring: October 1 - November 30

2. Persistence: The mod recalculates the season, ensuring that the correct season is always in effect.

Known Issues

- The mod defaults to summer if there is any issue determining the current season.
- Ensure the server’s time zone is correctly configured, as the mod relies on the system date to determine the season.

Support

This mod is provided as-is, with no official support. If bugs are reported I will do my best to fix.

It is intended for tinkerers and advanced users who understand how to modify and troubleshoot their game environment.

Please make sure to back up your game and mod files before making any changes.

License

This mod is licensed under the MIT License. See the LICENSE file for more details.

Credits:

- DewardianDev for the original All The Seasons mod which this is based on.

- sheepy for the Simple Season Selector mod which I used as a reference for updating to SPT 3.10.X as well as adapting certain features.

- bushtail for the Random Season Ripoff mod which I used as a reference for updating to SPT 3.11.X as well as adapting certain features.

versions.description:
> ### This release is for SPT **4.1.x** only
> This build will not run on SPT 4.0. If you're still on 4.0, stay on [v2.0.0](https://github.com/Dildz/Southern-Hemisphere-Seasons/releases/tag/v2.0.0).

### Fixed

- **The hourly season recheck now actually runs hourly.** It was comparing a value measured in seconds against a threshold written in milliseconds, so after the first check it only re-evaluated the season roughly every 41 days instead of every hour.

### Changed

- Rebuilt for **SPT 4.1.x** on .NET 10.
- Migrated to 4.1's mod API: the new metadata interface, the async load/update lifecycle with shutdown cancellation support, and direct config injection now that the old config server is gone.

### Notes

- **Your config carries over unchanged.** `config/config.jsonc` keeps the same three options with the same meanings - no edits needed when upgrading.
- Season values for `forceSeason` are unchanged: `0` Summer, `1` Autumn, `2` Winter, `3` Spring, `4` Late Autumn, `5` Early Spring, `null` auto-detect.

Ported mod to SPT 4.0.X

- Checks & updates season based on system date/time every hour
- Added seasonal event override

Updated for SPT 3.11.X  
Checks & updates season based on system date at raid start

Like the eedjit I can be, I forgot to rename the config file, very silly mistake...sorry  
If you downloaded v1.3.0 of the mod - simply rename *config.json* to *config.jsonc.*  
Download link has been updated.

Updated for SPT 3.10.X  
Additional 'Late Autumn' season implemented, 'Early Spring' & 'Storm' cause raid loading to fail & have been disabled until a fix is found.

Initial hub release.  
  
Please use the comment section for any issues/questions.
